implementation.validation_nesting: Within a replicate, first 16/64/256 rows of the same 256-path validation pool; not independent sizes
implementation.calibration: Independent 60-return path under GBM for matched_gbm, matched Heston otherwise; sample standard deviation ddof=1 annualized sqrt(252)
implementation.forecast: The 60-return volatility estimate multiplied by 0.75/1/1.25, frozen for each hedge episode; latent variance is never supplied to the candidate
implementation.qlike: log(hedge_vol^2/252)+mean(all validation one-observation squared log returns)/(hedge_vol^2/252); noisy conditional-second-moment proxy, not option implied volatility
implementation.fee_calculation: Risk-independent policies have identical positions at every fee. Run each once at zero fee; net_pnl=gross_pnl-turnover*fee_bps/10000 (r=0). Direct-fee equivalence independently tested.
implementation.reference: Same 12 calibrated-volatility/policy pairs evaluated on independent 16384-path reference; minimum reference MSE among reference mean-cost-feasible pairs. All selectors compared to that pair on the SAME reference paths. If selected pair violates reference budget, its signed difference can be negative; this is not constrained feasible regret.
implementation.fallback: If no eligible pair meets validation cost budget, choose minimum cost, then MSE, then candidate name; retain infeasibility.
implementation.statistical_unit: Independent full-procedure replicate (24), not individual test path or repeated candidate row
implementation.primary: heston, validation64, fee5: joint_mse minus forecast_first test MSE; pointwise two-sided Student-t interval across full-procedure replicates

discretization.comparisons: Independent fine-grid ensembles, not coupled Brownian refinement. Descriptive weak-moment and risk sensitivity, not proof of exactness or convergence order.

effective_simulation.primary: Heston matched,64 validation paths,5bps: joint_mse minus forecast_first test MSE, independent full-procedure replicates as inference units
effective_simulation.reference_oracle: Per replicate chosen-model class reference optimum evaluated on a separate large Monte Carlo sample; noisy, retrospective finite-class information benchmark, never a deployable selector
output_requirements: net MSE variance and bias squared decomposition
